name: Easy Chat Support – Capripio
author: Asif

sections.description:
Easy Chat Support – Capripio is a simple live chat plugin for WordPress. Add a live chat widget to your website and reply to visitors from your WordPress dashboard.

No Third-Party Service Required

Unlike many live chat plugins, Easy Chat Support – Capripio runs entirely on your own WordPress website.

  • No third-party chat service
  • No account or signup required
  • No API keys
  • No monthly subscription
  • No visitor data sent to another company
  • Install, activate, and start chatting in minutes

Your visitors chat directly with you, and you reply from your WordPress dashboard. Everything stays on your own website.

Live Chat Widget

  • Lightweight live chat widget
  • Works on desktop and mobile
  • Unlimited visitors
  • Unlimited conversations
  • Unlimited messages
  • Choose your widget color
  • Display the widget in the bottom-left or bottom-right corner
  • Welcome message
  • Offline message
  • Set your business hours

Dashboard Inbox

  • Reply from your WordPress dashboard
  • Real-time messaging
  • Search conversations
  • Close conversations when finished

Email Notifications

  • Get an email when a visitor sends a new message

Message Retention

  • Automatically delete old conversations after a set number of days
  • Delete conversations manually with one click
  • Choose how long to keep chat history

Fast and Lightweight

Easy Chat Support – Capripio is built for speed.

  • Loads only a small script and stylesheet
  • Checks for new messages only while the chat window is open
  • No unnecessary background processes

Upgrade to Pro

“Easy Chat Support Pro – Capripio” adds powerful features for growing teams.

  • Multiple support agents
  • Conversation assignment
  • Canned replies
  • Internal notes
  • Tags
  • File uploads
  • Typing indicators
  • Read receipts
  • Visitor details (browser, device, and country)
  • Company logo
  • Dark mode
  • CSV export

Learn more:
https://capripio.com/capripio-easy-chat-support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/capripio-easy-chat-support, or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Chat Support → Settings.
  4. Choose your widget color, position, welcome message, and business hours.
  5. Your live chat widget is ready. New messages will appear in Chat Support → Inbox.
sections.faq:
Do I need a third-party service?

No. Everything runs on your own WordPress website. You do not need to create an account, sign up for another service, or use API keys.

Does this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight. It loads a small script and stylesheet and checks for new messages only while the chat window is open.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Yes. You can choose your widget color, position, welcome message, offline message, and business hours.

Can I keep or delete old messages?

Yes. Keep your chat history forever or automatically delete conversations after a set number of days.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. “Easy Chat Support Pro – Capripio” includes multiple agents, canned replies, file uploads, internal notes, visitor details, and more.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. The chat widget is a floating element that works independently of your theme, so it works with most WordPress themes.
